verdict.rationale: Finix's marketing says more than 10 report types (transactions, disputes, fees) are automated and available in the dashboard. Its docs show seller payouts managed via Dashboard or API and webhooks for resource updates, which together give some programmatic hooks for reconciliation. However, the reports are described as dashboard-bound, with no evidence of scheduled file or API delivery to a finance stack. missing for 10: settlement/balance report API or scheduled file export (e.g., SFTP/CSV delivery), per-seller vs. rolled-up report breakdowns, explicit reconciliation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
